sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Back in the 1980s, when Louis Smuts was growing up in Johannesburg, South Africa,
sentences.zh: 早在20世纪80年代，当路易斯·斯穆茨在南非约翰内斯堡长大时，

sentences.en: his family couldn't go outside together without breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 他的家人如果一起出门就会触犯法律。

sentences.en: My father would never walk next to my mother.
sentences.zh: 我父亲绝不会走在我母亲旁边。

sentences.en: My mother would always walk behind him wherever they went.
sentences.zh: 无论去哪里，我母亲总是走在他身后。

sentences.en: Louis was too young to understand why his parents couldn't be seen together in Johannesburg,
sentences.zh: 路易斯当时太小，无法理解为什么他的父母不能一起出现在约翰内斯堡，

sentences.en: or as everyone calls it, Joburg.
sentences.zh: 或者像大家所叫的那样，约堡。

sentences.en: Louis just saw a world that treated them differently.
sentences.zh: 路易斯只看到一个以不同方式对待他们的世界。

sentences.en: You know, if your mother got sick and didn't have a medical aid,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你母亲生病了又没有医疗保险，

sentences.en: she'd go to a hospital out of the city.
sentences.zh: 她得去城外的医院。

sentences.en: Whereas with your dad, you'd go to what is the Joburg Gin,
sentences.zh: 而如果是你父亲，你就会去所谓的约堡金诊所，

sentences.en: which was around the corner from where we stayed.
sentences.zh: 它就在我们住所的街角。

sentences.en: Healthcare, like almost everything else in South Africa, was decided by race.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健和南非的几乎所有事情一样，都是由种族决定的。

sentences.en: Louis' father was white.
sentences.zh: 路易斯的父亲是白人。

sentences.en: His mother was colored, a local term for people of mixed race.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是有色人种，这是当地对混血儿的称呼。

sentences.en: They'd gotten married in neighboring Swaziland.
sentences.zh: 他们是在邻国的斯威士兰结的婚。

sentences.en: But back home, their marriage was against the law.
sentences.zh: 但回到家乡，他们的婚姻是违法的。

sentences.en: When Louis was a kid, only white people could move freely in cities here,
sentences.zh: 路易斯小时候，只有白人才能在这里的城市里自由移动，

sentences.en: live in the nicest neighborhoods, or access the best hospitals, schools, and jobs.
sentences.zh: 住在最好的街区，或是享有最好的医院、学校和工作。

sentences.en: This is Darshan Mudli.
sentences.zh: 这是达山·穆德利。

sentences.en: He's a South African journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一名南非记者。

sentences.en: Black people, on the other hand, lived in the crowded outskirts,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，黑人则住在拥挤的郊区，

sentences.en: which were far from just about everything you'd want in a city.
sentences.zh: 那里几乎远离你在城市里想要的一切。

sentences.en: The country's ruling white minority called this system apartheid,
sentences.zh: 这个国家执政的白人少数群体将这种制度称为种族隔离，

sentences.en: which literally translated to separateness.
sentences.zh: 其字面意思是隔离。

sentences.en: Our policy is one which is called by an Afrikaans' word apartheid.
sentences.zh: 我们的政策是一个用南非语称作种族隔离的词。

sentences.en: And I'm afraid that has been misunderstood so often.
sentences.zh: 我担心这个词经常被误解。

sentences.en: It could just as easily, and perhaps much better, be described as a policy of good neighborliness.
sentences.zh: 它同样可以，甚至更好地被描述为睦邻友好政策。

sentences.en: Apartheid leaders like Henrik Verfoot claimed that segregated cities were better for everyone.
sentences.zh: 像亨里克·费尔福特这样的种族隔离领导人声称，隔离的城市对每个人都更好。

sentences.en: And apartheid was strictly enforced.
sentences.zh: 而且种族隔离得到了严格执行。

sentences.en: Police would patrol neighborhoods to make sure that white people and black people weren't living together.
sentences.zh: 警察会在街区巡逻，以确保白人和黑人没有住在一起。

sentences.en: If you lived in a house, they'd come knocking on your door.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在房子里，他们会来敲你的门。

sentences.en: But the apartheid system was never airtight, and people found creative ways to slip through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 但种族隔离制度从未密不透风，人们找到了巧妙的方法钻空子。

sentences.en: If you lived in a high-rise building with five, six hundred flats in it,
sentences.zh: 如果你住在一栋有五六百套公寓的高层建筑里，

sentences.en: you know, they weren't going to go through each and every flat to come and look for any illegal persons.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们不可能去翻遍每一套公寓来寻找任何非法人员。

sentences.en: You could easily disappear into flatland.
sentences.zh: 你可以轻易地消失在公寓的世界里。

sentences.en: And over the years, many families, like Louie's, disappeared into one high-rise apartment building in particular.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多家庭像路易斯家一样，特别消失在某一栋高层公寓楼里。

sentences.en: A tower called Ponte City.
sentences.zh: 一座名为庞特城市的塔楼。

sentences.en: I don't think there's anybody in Johannesburg that doesn't know Ponte.
sentences.zh: 我认为约翰内斯堡没有人不知道庞特。

sentences.en: Might not have been there, but everybody knows Ponte.
sentences.zh: 可能没去过，但人人都知道庞特。

sentences.en: Even looking at Joburg's skyline now, Ponte's hard to miss.
sentences.zh: 即使现在看着约堡的天际线，庞特也让人无法忽视。

sentences.en: First of all, it's 54 stories tall.
sentences.zh: 首先，它有54层高。

sentences.en: That makes it the tallest apartment building on the entire African continent.
sentences.zh: 这使它成为整个非洲大陆最高的公寓楼。

sentences.en: And it certainly makes it taller than any of the other buildings around it.
sentences.zh: 而且它无疑比周围的任何其他建筑都要高。

sentences.en: It's also completely circular.
sentences.zh: 它也是完全呈圆形的。

sentences.en: If you were to look at Ponte from above, you'd see that the center's just this open, hollow core,
sentences.zh: 如果你从上方俯瞰庞特，你会发现中心只是这样一个开放、空心的核心，

sentences.en: designed to allow natural ventilation and to let in daylight.
sentences.zh: 旨在实现自然通风并引入日光。

sentences.en: The building looks kind of like a massive concrete toilet roll.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑看起来有点像一个巨大的混凝土卫生纸卷。

sentences.en: It's also got this glowing red billboard for a cell phone company wrapping around the top like a crown.
sentences.zh: 它的顶部还缠绕着一个发光的手机公司红色广告牌，就像一顶王冠。

sentences.en: So wherever you are in the city, you can easily spawn it.
sentences.zh: 所以无论你在城市的什么地方，你都能轻易认出它。

sentences.en: Ponte's larger-than-life architecture also comes with a larger-than-life reputation.
sentences.zh: 庞特超乎寻常的建筑风格也伴随着超乎寻常的名声。

sentences.en: For many, the building symbolizes Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这座建筑象征着约翰内斯堡。

sentences.en: Because over the past four decades, its fortunes have basically mirrored the cities.
sentences.zh: 因为在过去四十家里，它的命运基本反映了这座城市的命运。

sentences.en: Because of its scale, because of its size, its checkered history, its toughness, its roughness,
sentences.zh: 由于它的规模，由于它的体量，它斑驳的历史，它的坚韧，它的粗犷，

sentences.en: talks to a very Joburg condition.
sentences.zh: 诉说着一种非常典型的约堡状况。

sentences.en: That's Melinda Silverman, an architectural historian who studies inner-city Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 那是梅琳达·西尔弗曼，一位研究约翰内斯堡内城区的建筑历史学家。

sentences.en: It has spoken to a city which goes very rapidly through cycles of decline and prosperity and decline and prosperity.
sentences.zh: 它反映了一个经历着衰退与繁荣、衰退与繁荣急剧循环的城市。

sentences.en: Ponte has always been kind of a vertical waiting room for admission to South African society.
sentences.zh: 庞特一直以来就像是一个进入南非社会的垂直候诊室。

sentences.en: But it's also been a laboratory, a place where the city seems to try out new versions of itself.
sentences.zh: 但它也一直是一个实验室，一个这座城市似乎在尝试自身新版本的场所。

sentences.en: Years before Ponte became a hideaway for interracial families like Louis, it attracted a much different clientele.
sentences.zh: 在庞特成为路易斯等跨种族家庭的隐秘住所的多年前，它吸引了截然不同的客户群。

sentences.en: And to understand who first lived there, and why, we have to go back to the 1960s, before Ponte was even built.
sentences.zh: 为了解最初是谁住在那里以及原因，我们必须回到20世纪60年代，在庞特甚至还没建造之前。

sentences.en: At the start of the 60s, the apartheid system had been firmly in place for more than 10 years.
sentences.zh: 60年代初，种族隔离制度已经牢固确立了10多年。

sentences.en: And South Africa's economy was a rising star in the world.
sentences.zh: 南非经济是世界上一颗冉冉升起的新星。

sentences.en: It had just given birth to a new currency, the rand, which was already stronger than the US dollar.
sentences.zh: 它刚刚诞生了一种新货币——兰特，当时它已经比美元更强势。

sentences.en: The country's success was largely driven by its access to cheap black labor and its rich gold deposits.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的成功很大程度上是由其获得的廉价黑人劳动力和丰富的黄金储量推动的。

sentences.en: We were the major gold producers in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界主要的黄金生产国。

sentences.en: And the feeling was that if we could continue being the major gold producers
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉得是，如果我们能继续成为主要黄金生产国，

sentences.en: and keep an increasingly restive black population under control, the future was brilliant.
sentences.zh: 并控制住日益不安分的黑人人口，未来将是一片光明。

sentences.en: Unless, of course, you were black.
sentences.zh: 当然，除非你是黑人。

sentences.en: Over the next decade, foreign investment in South Africa doubled.
sentences.zh: 在接下来十年里，外国对南非的投资翻了一番。

sentences.en: But skilled workers were in short supply.
sentences.zh: 但技术工人严重短缺。

sentences.en: Because the government had denied the majority of the population a decent education,
sentences.zh: 由于政府剥夺了大多数人口接受良好教育的权利，

sentences.en: it had to fill the gap by recruiting single white men from all over Europe.
sentences.zh: 它不得不通过从欧洲各地招募单身白人男性来填补这一缺口。

sentences.en: The country's white population increased by over 50% between 1963 and 1972.
sentences.zh: 1963年至1972年间，该国的白人人口增加了50%以上。

sentences.en: These newcomers saw a strong economy and an idyllic life for white people.
sentences.zh: 这些新来者看到了强劲的经济和白人理想的生活。

sentences.en: With a level of privilege that you probably couldn't have found in any other part of the world.
sentences.zh: 这种特权水平你可能在世界的任何其他地方都找不到。

sentences.en: If you were a middle class person living in an apartment in England, in America,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个住在英国、美国公寓里的小康阶层人士，

sentences.en: you would probably have had to have washed your own dishes and made your own beds.
sentences.zh: 你可能不得不自己洗碗、自己铺床。

sentences.en: Whereas if you were a middle class person living in South Africa,
sentences.zh: 而如果你是一个住在南非的中产阶级人士，

sentences.en: you probably had at least two people doing that stuff for you.
sentences.zh: 你可能至少有两个人帮你做这些事。

sentences.en: And there was one square mile of inner city Joburg, the future site of Ponte Tower,
sentences.zh: 约堡内城区有一平方英里，也就是庞特大厦未来的所在地，

sentences.en: that was a regular landing place for these European migrants in the 1960s and 70s.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪60和70年代这些欧洲移民经常登陆的地方。

sentences.en: It was home to the city's most famous bars and live music joints.
sentences.zh: 这里是该市最著名的酒吧和现场音乐场所的所在地。

sentences.en: A place where specialty stores sold French magazines, Italian shoes and American rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 一个由专卖店出售法国杂志、意大利鞋和美国摇滚乐的地方。

sentences.en: It had a shiny, vibrant, bohemian edge that people compared to New York's Greenwich Village or London's Soho District.
sentences.zh: 它有一种光鲜、充满活力、波西米亚式的边缘感，人们将其与纽约的格林威治村或伦敦的苏荷区相提并论。

sentences.en: But it was also a place that felt almost like it wasn't in South Africa at all.
sentences.zh: 但它也是一个感觉几乎根本不在南非的地方。

sentences.en: Like most of Joburg's nicest neighborhoods, this area was zoned exclusively for white people.
sentences.zh: 就像约堡大多数最好的街区一样，这个区域是专门为白人划分的。

sentences.en: Black South Africans could work there, but unless they were live-in servants,
sentences.zh: 南非黑人可以在那里工作，但除非他们是住家仆人，

sentences.en: they had to be out by nightfall each evening.
sentences.zh: 否则他们必须在每天夜幕降临前离开。

sentences.en: Developers could hardly satisfy the demand for high-rise apartments in this part of the city.
sentences.zh: 开发商几乎无法满足该市这一地区对高层公寓的需求。

sentences.en: Buildings kept getting bigger and taller.
sentences.zh: 建筑物越建越大，越建越高。

sentences.en: But that wasn't the only thing fueling the development of Joburg's new high-rises.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是推动约堡新建高层建筑的唯一因素。

sentences.en: The other sort of driver, I would say, was ideological.
sentences.zh: 我想说，另一种驱动力是意识形态上的。

sentences.en: And it was this extraordinary sense of white confidence.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非同寻常的白人自信感。

sentences.en: That this was a great economy, these were good times, this was white people wanting to make their mark on the landscape.
sentences.zh: 这是一个伟大的经济体，这是好时光，这是白人想要在风景中留下自己的印记。

sentences.en: South Africa as a modern, progressive, impressive place.
sentences.zh: 将南非打造为一个现代、进步、令人印象深刻的地方。

sentences.en: Of course, South Africa was neither truly modern nor progressive at this time.
sentences.zh: 当然，当时的南非既谈不上真正现代，也谈不上进步。

sentences.en: This was the era of African independence.
sentences.zh: 这是非洲独立的时代。

sentences.en: Across the continent, old colonies were falling like dominoes.
sentences.zh: 在整个非洲大陆，旧殖民地像多米诺骨牌一样倒塌。

sentences.en: And by the mid-1960s, most African countries were black-ruled.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪60年代中期，大多数非洲国家都由黑人统治。

sentences.en: This decade is the decade of African independence.
sentences.zh: 这个十年是非洲独立的十年。

sentences.en: The people of Ghana see their freedom as more than a local triumph.
sentences.zh: 加纳人民将他们的自由视为不仅仅是地方上的胜利。

sentences.en: For they are now the only all-African dominion in the British Commonwealth.
sentences.zh: 因为他们现在是英联邦中唯一的全非洲自治领。

sentences.en: In the new Africa, one more independent country, the state of Uganda.
sentences.zh: 在新非洲，又一个独立的国家，乌干达国。

sentences.en: To much of the world, South Africa's white government was starting to look pretty backwards.
sentences.zh: 对世界上许多人来说，南非的白人政府开始显得相当落后。

sentences.en: And it didn't help that the country had recently thrown several of the anti-apartheid movement's most powerful leaders in jail for life.
sentences.zh: 该国最近判处了反种族隔离运动几位最有权势的领导人无期徒刑，这也无济于事。

sentences.en: Including a young lawyer named Nelson Mandela.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一位名叫纳尔逊·曼德拉的年轻律师。

sentences.en: But Joburg's new buildings kept getting bigger and more audacious.
sentences.zh: 但约堡的新建筑越来越大，越来越大胆。

sentences.en: Almost as if the government was trying to prove its worldliness.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像政府在试图证明其老练成熟。

sentences.en: By the early 1970s, huge skyscrapers were sprouting up across central Joburg, including Ponte.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪70年代初，巨大的摩天大楼在约堡市中心拔地而起，包括庞特。

sentences.en: Ponte starts off being a tower.
sentences.zh: 庞特一开始是一座塔。

sentences.en: A round tower.
sentences.zh: 一座圆塔。

sentences.en: That's architect Rodney Kroskov, who was one of the three architects who designed the building.
sentences.zh: 那是建筑师罗德尼·克罗斯科夫，他是设计这座建筑的三位建筑师之一。

sentences.en: So now imagine again this tall tower, 54 stories tall, with a hole down the middle.
sentences.zh: 现在再次想象这座高塔，54层高，中间有一个洞。

sentences.en: And the whole outside of it, it is made out of raw concrete.
sentences.zh: 它的整个外部都是由毛坯混凝土制成的。

sentences.en: Unpainted, unpolished, and then at its foot, it's really anchored so beautifully down.
sentences.zh: 未经粉刷，未经抛光，然后在它的底部，它是如此美丽地锚固在地基上。

sentences.en: People, once upon a time, said it looks a bit like a wedding cake.
sentences.zh: 曾经有人说它看起来有点像婚礼蛋糕。

sentences.en: But not everyone agreed the building was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都认为这座建筑很美。

sentences.en: Some thought it looked like an ugly, brutalist wedding cake.
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得它看起来像一个丑陋的野兽派婚礼蛋糕。

sentences.en: Straight after it was built, it was voted as the second ugliest building in Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 它建成后不久，就被评为约翰内斯堡第二丑的建筑。

sentences.en: Not even the honor of being the first uglieSt.
sentences.zh: 甚至连获得第一丑的荣誉都没有。

sentences.en: The second uglieSt.
sentences.zh: 第二丑。

sentences.en: When can you mean the second ugliest?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能说第二丑呢？

sentences.en: Second ugliest or not, Ponte Tower was popular.
sentences.zh: 不管是不是第二丑，庞特大厦都很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Residents started moving in even before the building was finished,
sentences.zh: 甚至在大楼完工之前，居民们就开始搬进去了，

sentences.en: lured by its furnished flats and panoramic city views.
sentences.zh: 被其带家具的公寓和全景城市景观所吸引。

sentences.en: All the units in Ponte faced both inward and outward,
sentences.zh: 庞特的所有单元都朝内和朝外，

sentences.en: with entrances wrapping around the central core.
sentences.zh: 入口环绕着核心筒。

sentences.en: From one side of the building, you could see the entire downtown skyline.
sentences.zh: 从大楼的一侧，你可以看到整个市中心的天际线。

sentences.en: From another, you could catch entire rugby matches at the city's main stadium.
sentences.zh: 从另一侧，你可以欣赏到该市主要体育场的整场橄榄球比赛。

sentences.en: By the time Ponte was completed in 1975, its 470 flats were in high demand.
sentences.zh: 到1975年庞特建成时，其470套公寓的需求量很大。

sentences.en: There were all sorts of analogies about how it was going to use as much electricity as the average small town in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 当时各种类比都在讨论它将消耗多少电量，相当于南非一个普通的小镇。

sentences.en: The developers saw it that way too.
sentences.zh: 开发商也是这么看的。

sentences.en: On Ponte's ground floor, they built an elaborate shopping mall
sentences.zh: 在庞特底楼，他们建造了一个精致的购物中心，

sentences.en: and schemed about putting a miniature ski slope in the open core.
sentences.zh: 并策划在开放式核心区修建一个微型滑雪场。

sentences.en: So we had restaurants, butcher, baker, candlestick maker designed in that space.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在那个空间设计了餐馆、肉铺、面包店、烛台制造商。

sentences.en: And we really did see it as a little city.
sentences.zh: 我们确实把它看作是一个小城市。

sentences.en: But even as Ponte's new residents were moving in, the city around them was cracking apart.
sentences.zh: 但就在庞特的新居民搬进来的时候，他们周围的城市正在碎裂。

sentences.en: At this time, Johannesburg's inner city was almost exclusively white.
sentences.zh: 当时，约翰内斯堡的内城区几乎全都是白人。

sentences.en: Black South Africans lived on the edges of the city in communities called townships.
sentences.zh: 南非黑人住在城市边缘被称为乡镇的社区里。

sentences.en: And 12 miles southwest of Ponte, in a black township called Soweto, a new revolt against apartheid had begun.
sentences.zh: 在庞特西南12英里处，在一个名为索韦托的黑人乡镇，一场反抗种族隔离的新起义已经爆发。

sentences.en: What began as a black protest against being taught in Afrikaans,
sentences.zh: 最初是黑人抗议接受南非语教育，

sentences.en: a language they regard as useless and that of their masters,
sentences.zh: 他们认为这种语言毫无用处，是主子的语言，

sentences.en: is now a manifestation of urban black frustration.
sentences.zh: 现在这成了城市黑人沮丧情绪的宣泄。

sentences.en: Protests escalated.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动升级。

sentences.en: And on June 16, 1976, police killed at least 176 high school students during a peaceful protest march.
sentences.zh: 1976年6月16日，警察在一次和平抗议游行中杀害了至少176名高中生。

sentences.en: Images of the massacre quickly circled the globe, inspiring renewed calls to end white rule.
sentences.zh: 大屠杀的照片迅速传遍全球，激发了结束白人统治的再次呼吁。

sentences.en: As a pall of smoke rises over this black community, so rises African anticipation.
sentences.zh: 随着一缕浓烟在这个黑人社区升起，非洲的期望也随之升起。

sentences.en: Throughout Southern Africa, they see minority white regimes falling or coming under greater pressure.
sentences.zh: 在整个南部非洲，他们看到少数白人政权正在倒台或面临更大的压力。

sentences.en: The Soweto uprising also sent Joburg's urban planning dreams crashing.
sentences.zh: 索韦托起义也让约堡的城市规划梦想破灭了。

sentences.en: The June 16 uprising and the international sanctions and boycotts that followed helped destroy the country's economy.
sentences.zh: 6月16日的起义以及随之而来的国际制裁和抵制，摧毁了国家的经济。

sentences.en: It became difficult to keep all the newly constructed high-rises fully occupied.
sentences.zh: 让所有新建的高层建筑保持满租变得十分困难。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the crashing economy.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是经济崩溃的问题。

sentences.en: Like many cities around the world, Johannesburg had started to experience a wave of suburbanization,
sentences.zh: 像世界上许多城市一样，约翰内斯堡也开始经历一波郊区化浪潮，

sentences.en: with white people moving out of the inner city and into new suburbs.
sentences.zh: 白人纷纷搬离市中心，搬进新的郊区。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, many black South Africans were fleeing from the poverty and violence of the townships.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，许多南非黑人正逃离黑人居住区的贫困和暴力。

sentences.en: For them, the inner city was an alluring option, especially Ponte.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，市中心是一个极具吸引力的选择，尤其是蓬蒂大厦。

sentences.en: First of all, the flats there would have been more affordable.
sentences.zh: 首先，那里的公寓会更买得起。

sentences.en: Really good location.
sentences.zh: 地理位置非常好。

sentences.en: The ability to be really near to the workplaces that still existed in the inner city.
sentences.zh: 能够非常靠近市中心仍然存在的那些工作场所。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, it was still illegal for black, Indian and colored South Africans to live in these areas.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，黑人、印度裔和有色人种南非人居住在这些地区仍然是违法的。

sentences.en: But the scale and density of the inner city made the laws harder to enforce.
sentences.zh: 但市中心的规模和密度使得这些法律更难以执行。

sentences.en: I think the anonymity that really high-density living offered,
sentences.zh: 我认为高密度居住所带来的匿名性，

sentences.en: which meant that people would have been less conspicuous if they were legal.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果他们合法的话，人们就不会那么显眼。

sentences.en: There was an Italian gentleman who had a black lady as a wife.
sentences.zh: 有一位意大利绅士，他的妻子是一位黑人女性。

sentences.en: There was a French gentleman who also had a colored wife.
sentences.zh: 还有一位法国绅士，他也有一个有色人种妻子。

sentences.en: That's Louis Smuts again, whose parents were in an illegal interracial marriage.
sentences.zh: 这又是路易·斯穆茨的话，他的父母曾经历过非法的跨种族婚姻。

sentences.en: He's talking about some of the other families who also lived in Ponte in the early 1980s.
sentences.zh: 他正在谈论20世纪80年代初同样住在蓬蒂的一些其他家庭。

sentences.en: As the lines between black and white began to blur in buildings like Ponte,
sentences.zh: 随着蓬蒂这样的建筑中黑人和白人之间的界限开始模糊，

sentences.en: South Africans coined a new term for the phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 南非人为这种现象创造了一个新词。

sentences.en: They called it greying.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为“灰色化”。

sentences.en: For Louis, gray areas were an escape.
sentences.zh: 对路易来说，灰色地带是一种逃避。

sentences.en: Ponte was a place where his family could be together, freely, without fear of arrest or public scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 蓬蒂是一个让他的家人能够自由聚在一起的地方，不用担心被捕或公众的审视。

sentences.en: I don't ever remember seeing any building raids or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我不记得曾见过任何搜查建筑或类似的事情。

sentences.en: You almost had protection being in the flatland, you know,
sentences.zh: 住在公寓区里，你几乎就有了某种保护，你知道的，

sentences.en: because there were so many places going to a flat here, going to a flat there.
sentences.zh: 因为这里有太多不同的公寓，进出这里或那里。

sentences.en: You know, they weren't going to close down a whole block of flats at once.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们不可能一下子封锁整栋公寓楼。

sentences.en: But that didn't mean that there weren't stresses associated with life in Ponte.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着住在蓬蒂没有压力。

sentences.en: Police regularly set up checkpoints to monitor who came in and out of black and white areas of the city.
sentences.zh: 警察定期设立检查站，监督谁进出城市的黑人和白人区域。

sentences.en: When Louis' family went through these checkpoints,
sentences.zh: 当路易的家人通过这些检查站时，

sentences.en: his mother would sit in the back seat, posing as the family's maid.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲会坐在后座上，假扮成家里的女佣。

sentences.en: She'd have to sit in the back.
sentences.zh: 她必须坐在后面。

sentences.en: It was plain and simple as that she sat in the back.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单明了，她就坐在后面。

sentences.en: Black and coloured people who were legally settled in the inner city also struck a hard bargain.
sentences.zh: 合法定居在市中心的黑人和有色人种也做出了艰难的妥协。

sentences.en: Landlords would turn a blind eye to the colour of the resident's skin,
sentences.zh: 房东会对居民的肤色睁一只眼闭一只眼，

sentences.en: and residents would have to turn a blind eye to rising rents and poor maintenance.
sentences.zh: 而居民则必须对不断上涨的房租和糟糕的维护睁一只眼闭一只眼。

sentences.en: Their status of illegality, I think, was absolutely critical to the decline,
sentences.zh: 我认为，他们的非法身份对大厦的衰落绝对至关重要，

sentences.en: because the minute you are an illegal tenant, you have no protection of the law.
sentences.zh: 因为只要你是一个非法租户，你就没有任何法律保护。

sentences.en: So rents can be ramped up.
sentences.zh: 所以房租可以大幅上涨。

sentences.en: Then if rents are ramped up, how do you afford the rent?
sentences.zh: 然后如果房租上涨了，你怎么付得起房租？

sentences.en: You sublet.
sentences.zh: 你转租出去。

sentences.en: And then the rents go up even further, and then you sublet even more.
sentences.zh: 接着房租涨得更高，然后你就转租更多。

sentences.en: Inside Ponte, apartments started to get crowded and grimy,
sentences.zh: 在蓬蒂内部，公寓开始变得拥挤和肮脏，

sentences.en: plumbing broke down.
sentences.zh: 管道系统坏了。

sentences.en: Trash began to fill the open core in the centre of the building like an oversized concrete garbage can.
sentences.zh: 垃圾开始填满大楼中央的露天空井，就像一个超大的混凝土垃圾桶。

sentences.en: There were giant piles of old mattresses, furniture, and rubble.
sentences.zh: 那里堆积着如山的旧床垫、家具和瓦砾。

sentences.en: Eventually, legend spread that the trash had piled up so high it reached the 14th story of the building.
sentences.zh: 最终，坊间流传着这样一个传说：垃圾堆得太高，甚至触及了大楼的14层。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, banks stopped issuing home loans in the area,
sentences.zh: 很快，银行停止在该地区发放房屋贷款，

sentences.en: and white people kept moving out.
sentences.zh: 白人也源源不断地搬走。

sentences.en: By the late 1980s, what you thought of Ponte and the surrounding neighbourhood called Hillbrow
sentences.zh: 到了80年代末，你对蓬蒂以及周边被称为希尔布罗的街区的看法，

sentences.en: probably depended a lot on the colour of your skin.
sentences.zh: 很可能很大程度上取决于你的肤色。

sentences.en: White suburbanites would have been terrified to go into Hillbrow,
sentences.zh: 白人郊区居民会对进入希尔布罗感到恐惧，

sentences.en: and Hillbrow would have been a place of fear and blight and darkness.
sentences.zh: 而希尔布罗对他们来说是一个充满恐惧、衰败和黑暗的地方。

sentences.en: Whereas, I think, for people in the townships...
sentences.zh: 然而，我认为，对于居住区的人们来说……

sentences.en: That is, mostly black and coloured people.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，主要是黑人和有色人种。

sentences.en: Hillbrow would have been this great beacon of opportunity.
sentences.zh: 希尔布罗将是这样一个充满机遇的伟大灯塔。

sentences.en: Your way into the city, your way of experiencing urban life.
sentences.zh: 这是你进入城市的方式，是你体验城市生活的方式。

sentences.en: And all these changes in the inner city were foreshadowing a much bigger change
sentences.zh: 而市中心的所有这些变化都在预示着一个更大的巨变，

sentences.en: that was about to happen to all of South Africa.
sentences.zh: 这个巨变即将降临到整个南非。

sentences.en: On February 2nd, 1990, then-president F.
sentences.zh: 1990年2月2日，时任总统F

sentences.en: W.
sentences.zh: ·W

sentences.en: de Klerk went in front of parliament
sentences.zh: ·德克勒克来到议会面前，

sentences.en: to give his annual State of the Nation speech.
sentences.zh: 发表了他年度国情咨文演讲。

sentences.en: Today, I'm able to announce far-reaching decisions.
sentences.zh: 今天，我能够宣布具有深远意义的决定。

sentences.en: For three decades, the apartheid government had banned many anti-apartheid political parties.
sentences.zh: 三十年来，种族隔离政府取缔了许多反种族隔离政党。

sentences.en: They arrested their members and sometimes forced them into exile.
sentences.zh: 他们逮捕了其成员，有时还迫使他们流亡国外。

sentences.en: No one was expecting the president to announce the end of that practice.
sentences.zh: 没有人预料到总统会宣布结束这种做法。

sentences.en: He shocked nearly everyone watching.
sentences.zh: 他的话震惊了几乎所有观看直播的人。

sentences.en: The prohibition of the African National Congress, the Pan-Africanist Congress,
sentences.zh: 非洲人国民大会、泛非主义者大会、

sentences.en: the South African Communist Party is being rescinded.
sentences.zh: 南非共产党受到的禁令正在被撤销。

sentences.en: The government has taken a firm decision to release Mr. Mandela unconditionally.
sentences.zh: 政府已经做出坚定决定，无条件释放曼德拉先生。

sentences.en: This speech would change the course of South African history.
sentences.zh: 这次演讲将改变南非的历史进程。

sentences.en: A week later, after 27 years in prison for treason, Nelson Mandela was free.
sentences.zh: 一周后，在因叛国罪入狱27年后，纳尔逊·曼德拉重获自由。

sentences.en: And after decades of struggle, the end of apartheid was suddenly imminent.
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的斗争，种族隔离的结束突然间迫在眉睫。

sentences.en: From all over the world, exiled political activists began to return.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的流亡政治活动人士开始返回。

sentences.en: They wanted to help shape a dramatically changing country.
sentences.zh: 他们想要参与塑造一个发生巨变的国家。

sentences.en: I think it was 1991, the year that we came back.
sentences.zh: 我想那是1991年，我们回国的那一年。

sentences.en: That's Lenswe Mokhatle, an anti-apartheid activist who fled South Africa in 1981.
sentences.zh: 说话的是伦斯韦·莫哈特莱，他是一名反种族隔离活动人士，于1981年逃离南非。

sentences.en: Like many other returning exiles, Lenswe took advantage of the centrality and cheap rent of the inner city
sentences.zh: 像许多其他回国的流亡者一样，伦斯韦利用了市中心的核心位置和低廉租金，

sentences.en: and moved into a friend's 24th floor apartment in Ponti Tower.
sentences.zh: 搬进了朋友位于蓬蒂大厦24楼的一间公寓。

sentences.en: Ponti and the surrounding neighborhood were still run down.
sentences.zh: 蓬蒂及其周边社区依然破败不堪。

sentences.en: But Lenswe was surprised to find the area felt a lot like the western cities where he'd spent the past decade.
sentences.zh: 但伦斯韦惊讶地发现，这个地区感觉很像他度过过去十年的西方城市。

sentences.en: That's where the music was happening, 24-hour food outlets that we had not seen anywhere else were there.
sentences.zh: 那是音乐响起的地方，我们在其他任何地方都没有见过全天候营业的餐饮店都在那里。

sentences.en: So the lights were on throughout.
sentences.zh: 所以灯光彻夜通明。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like being in New York.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像在纽约一样。

sentences.en: Some of the old European cafes from the 50s and 60s were still standing, serving late-night espressos and thick schnitzels.
sentences.zh: 一些50和60年代的老式欧洲咖啡馆依然开着，供应深夜浓缩咖啡和厚实的炸肉排。

sentences.en: But alongside them were news shops and nightclubs, including one run by the famous South African trumpeter,
sentences.zh: 但在它们旁边是新的商店和夜总会，其中包括一家由著名南非小号手经营的夜总会，

sentences.en: Hugh Masekela, who had recently returned from his own exile.
sentences.zh: 他就是休·马瑟塞拉，他最近刚结束自己的流亡生涯归来。

sentences.en: So if you wanted to find anybody who were around, we never used to sleep.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想找任何还在周围的人，我们从来不睡觉。

sentences.en: Instead, Mokhatle says they stayed up all night, talking about the future of their new country over beers and brandies.
sentences.zh: 相反，莫哈特莱说，他们彻夜未眠，一边喝着啤酒和白兰地，一边畅谈新国家的未来。

sentences.en: Tabo Mbeki, who would later become president of South Africa, lived in the building next to Ponti.
sentences.zh: 塔博·姆贝基后来成为了南非总统，他就住在蓬蒂旁边的建筑里。

sentences.en: At the time of the first democratic election in 1994, one observer counted 50 of the new members of parliament staying in Ponti and the surrounding area.
sentences.zh: 在1994年首次民主选举时，一位观察家统计有50名新国会议员住在蓬蒂及周边地区。

sentences.en: But the end of apartheid didn't represent the end of Ponti Tower's evolution.
sentences.zh: 但种族隔离的结束并不意味着蓬蒂大厦演变的终结。

sentences.en: The transition to black rule in South Africa also meant the end of the country's tightly closed borders,
sentences.zh: 南非向黑人统治的过渡也意味着该国紧闭边境的结束，

sentences.en: which for decades had cracked open only for white immigrants and a few laborers from the surrounding countries.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这些边境只对白人移民和来自周边国家的少数劳工微微敞开。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1990s, immigrants began arriving in Johannesburg by the tens of thousands.
sentences.zh: 整个20世纪90年代，移民开始以数万人的规模涌入约翰内斯堡。

sentences.en: And many of them landed in Ponti.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人落脚在蓬蒂。

sentences.en: That's footage from a film called Africa Shafted by Ingrid Martens.
sentences.zh: 那是英格丽德·马滕斯拍摄的一部名为《非洲电梯》的纪录片中的素材。

sentences.en: She filmed entirely inside of Ponti's elevators.
sentences.zh: 她完全是在蓬蒂的电梯内部拍摄的。

sentences.en: That's why it sounds like there are doors opening and shutting in the background all the time.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么背景听起来总是一直有门在开开关关。

sentences.en: Martens found people from dozens of countries living in the building,
sentences.zh: 马滕斯发现几十个国家的人住在这栋大楼里，

sentences.en: mostly in crowded apartments shared by several families.
sentences.zh: 大部分人挤在几个家庭合住的拥挤公寓里。

sentences.en: Some had come for work.
sentences.zh: 有些人是为了工作而来。

sentences.en: Others were fleeing political persecution.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则是为了逃离政治迫害。

sentences.en: But they shared one important experience with past residents.
sentences.zh: 但他们与过去的居民有一个共同的重要体验。

sentences.en: For them, Ponti was a place you could start over.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，蓬蒂是一个可以重新开始的地方。

sentences.en: I just want to give my little boy the life that I never had.
sentences.zh: 我只想给我的小男孩我从未拥有过的人生。

sentences.en: Over the years, Ponti, like South Africa itself, continued to have its ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 多年来，蓬蒂和南非本身一样，经历了起起落落。

sentences.en: By the late 90s, the building's physical decline made it a haven for criminals,
sentences.zh: 到90年代末，大楼物理上的衰败使其成为罪犯的避难所，

sentences.en: who moved into the building and ran it like a vertical slum.
sentences.zh: 他们搬进大楼，像经营垂直贫民窟一样管理它。

sentences.en: But Ponti still remained a place of big ideas and wild experimentation.
sentences.zh: 但蓬蒂仍然是一个充满宏大构想和疯狂实验的地方。

sentences.en: Developers made a few attempts to gentrify the tower and turn it into luxury apartments again.
sentences.zh: 开发商曾几次尝试将这座大厦高档化，将其重新变成豪华公寓。

sentences.en: But ultimately, those plans didn't really work.
sentences.zh: 但最终，这些计划并没有真正奏效。

sentences.en: Ponti today remains a lot like it was at the end of Apartheid.
sentences.zh: 如今的蓬蒂依然很像它在种族隔离结束时的样子。

sentences.en: A home for recently arrived immigrants from all over Africa.
sentences.zh: 一个来自全非洲各地的初来乍到的移民的家。

sentences.en: On a recent Saturday morning, a pair of kids are battling it out on a foosball table at the base of Ponti City.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一个周六早晨，两个孩子正在蓬蒂城底部的桌上足球台上一决高下。

sentences.en: You can tell it's a close game.
sentences.zh: 看得出来这是一场旗鼓相当的比赛。

sentences.en: Just down the road, people are crowding around a wall that's covered in hundreds of scribbled slips of paper
sentences.zh: 就在路边，人们挤在一面贴满了数百张用几种不同语言涂写的小纸条的墙壁周围，

sentences.en: in several different languages.
sentences.zh: 用几种不同的语言。

sentences.en: Some are torn or stuck over older ones with wads of bubblegum.
sentences.zh: 有些纸条被撕破了，或者用一团泡泡糖粘在旧纸条上面。

sentences.en: It's a sort of analog CraigsliSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一种模拟版的分类广告网站。

sentences.en: A message board for newcomers searching for accommodation in Ponti and around Hillbrow.
sentences.zh: 这是一个供寻找蓬蒂和希尔布罗周边住宿的新来者查阅的留言板。

sentences.en: I'm looking for a lady or a guy to rent a bedroom or a balcony at 1801 Metropolitan Tadop.
sentences.zh: 我在寻找一位女士或男士来合租大都会塔多普1801号的一间卧室或阳台。

sentences.en: And I ask a man to share the room with me.
sentences.zh: 我邀请一位男士和我合住这个房间。

sentences.en: And the list goes on.
sentences.zh: 这样的清单还有很多。

sentences.en: Sifting through the messages, the demand feels limitless.
sentences.zh: 仔细翻看这些留言，需求似乎是无限的。

sentences.en: Like South Africa itself, Ponti has gone from a symbol of white opulence to something far more complicated.
sentences.zh: 就像南非本身一样，蓬蒂已经从白人富裕的象征变成了复杂得多的存在。

sentences.en: It's hopeful, and it's a little rough around the edges.
sentences.zh: 它充满希望，而且带有一点粗粝感。

sentences.en: It's a microcosm of the country's history.
sentences.zh: 它是这个国家历史的一个缩影。

sentences.en: But it's also a place that moves on.
sentences.zh: 但它也是一个不断向前发展的空间。

sentences.en: And the strange concrete tube at the center of Joburg's skyline
sentences.zh: 而约堡天际线中心那个奇怪的混凝土管，

sentences.en: continues to play the same role for newcomers that it always has.
sentences.zh: 继续为新来者扮演着它一直以来扮演的角色。

sentences.en: The diversity is the same.
sentences.zh: 多样性是一样的。

sentences.en: You know, there might have been Czechoslovakians, Portuguese, Italians, and Danes living in Hillbrow then.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当年住在希尔布罗的可能有捷克斯洛伐克人、葡萄牙人、意大利人和丹麦人。

sentences.en: But now they're Cameroonians, Angolans, Nigerians, Zimbabweans, etc., etc.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们是喀麦隆人、安哥拉人、尼日利亚人、津巴布韦人等等。

sentences.en: It always has been your entry point into the city.
sentences.zh: 它一直都是你进入这座城市的入口。

sentences.en: So did Ponti Tower seem vaguely familiar, but you can't quite put your finger on it?
sentences.zh: 所以，蓬蒂大厦是不是让你觉得有点面熟，但又说不出在哪里见过？

sentences.en: It's because you probably saw it or a tower inspired by it in a movie.
sentences.zh: 那是因为你可能在某部电影里看过它，或者看过受它启发建造的大厦。

sentences.en: We have a little epilogue about Ponti's life on screen after this.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们有一个关于蓬蒂在大银幕上的生平的小尾声。

sentences.en: Even though we only heard Dasha Mudli's voice in this episode,
sentences.zh: 尽管我们在这一集中只听到了达沙·穆德利的聲音，

sentences.en: it was reported by two people, actually.
sentences.zh: 但实际上是由两个人进行报道的。

sentences.en: The second reporter is Ryan Brown, and she was a resident of Ponti Tower
sentences.zh: 第二位记者是瑞安·布朗，她曾是蓬蒂大厦的居民，

sentences.en: and has done a lot of reporting on the place.
sentences.zh: 并且对这个地方做过大量报道。

sentences.en: And one of the things about Ponti that is pretty interesting
sentences.zh: 关于蓬蒂，有一点非常有趣，

sentences.en: is that even though you might not know its actual history or even know its name,
sentences.zh: 那就是尽管你可能不知道它的真实历史，甚至不知道它的名字，

sentences.en: you might feel like it's kind of familiar as a place.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得这个地方有点眼熟。

sentences.en: And the reason is because it has been depicted in movies in different ways.
sentences.zh: 原因在于它已经在电影中以不同的方式被描绘过。

sentences.en: And I asked Ryan to talk to me about that.
sentences.zh: 我请瑞安和我谈谈这方面的话题。

sentences.en: Well, Ponti has actually made quite a number of cameos in film and other popular culture.
sentences.zh: 嗯，蓬蒂实际上在电影和其他流行文化中客串过相当多的次数。

sentences.en: Most recently in the last Resident Evil film as a site of the zombie apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 最近的一次是在上一部《生化危机》电影中，作为僵尸末日的发生地。

sentences.en: It was in District 9 a few years ago and the robot-becoming-human story Chappie a couple years ago, too.
sentences.zh: 几年前它出现在《第九区》里，几年前那部关于机器人变人的电影《超能查派》里也有它。

sentences.en: And it's made a cameo in a number of other films, too.
sentences.zh: 而且它还在许多其他电影中客串过。

sentences.en: Interestingly, not always films that are set in Johannesburg,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这些电影并不总是以约翰内斯堡为背景，

sentences.en: but always films that are set in places where there's something either kind of apocalyptic
sentences.zh: 但它们总是在那些发生着某种末日景象、

sentences.en: or just, you know, sort of gritty and messy going on.
sentences.zh: 或者是那种，你知道的，粗粝杂乱事情的地方取景。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: It has that vibe.
sentences.zh: 它确实有那种氛围。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily a Johannesburg vibe.
sentences.zh: 这不一定非得是约翰内斯堡的氛围。

sentences.en: It's the vibe of apocalypse that it gives off.
sentences.zh: 那是它散发出的末日氛围。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 对，完全如此。

sentences.en: But, you know, you have to sort of wonder where did filmmakers get the idea
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，你难免会想，电影制作者们是从哪里得到的灵感，

sentences.en: that Ponti would be the scene for the apocalypse?
sentences.zh: 认为庞蒂会成为末日场景的？

sentences.en: And I think it's rooted in the kind of stereotypes that people have about the inner city of Johannesburg,
sentences.zh: 我想这根源于人们对约翰内斯堡市中心的一些刻板印象，

sentences.en: which are then in turn, you know, rooted in, I think,
sentences.zh: 而这些印象反过来，你知道的，又根源于，我认为，

sentences.en: the fears that a lot of South Africans have about the city and what it's become since the end of apartheid.
sentences.zh: 许多南非人对这座城市以及它在种族隔离结束后变成这副模样的恐惧。

sentences.en: And there's also a number of films where it's not necessarily Ponti or it's not necessarily Johannesburg,
sentences.zh: 而且还有许多电影中，它不一定是庞蒂，也不一定是约翰内斯堡，

sentences.en: but there's this, the idea of a tower that's a city in and of itself that is its own sort of dark place.
sentences.zh: 但有这样一种概念：一座塔本身就是一座城市，是一个它自己的某种黑暗场所。

sentences.en: Dread, for example, reminds me of the way that people talk about Ponti City as well.
sentences.zh: 比如《新特警判官》，也让我想起人们谈论庞蒂城的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: And an interesting thing about Dread is that the movie itself was filmed in Johannesburg
sentences.zh: 关于《新特警判官》一个有趣的事是，这部电影本身是在约翰内斯堡拍摄的，

sentences.en: and they didn't use Ponti as a set, but then there's a sort of massive apartment tower in the film,
sentences.zh: 他们没有把庞蒂当成布景，但电影中有一种巨大的公寓大楼，

sentences.en: a 200-story building that has a hollow open core.
sentences.zh: 一栋拥有中空核心的200层建筑。

sentences.en: So you have to wonder, you know, sort of where they got that idea.
sentences.zh: 所以你难免会想，你知道的，他们是从哪里得到这个主意的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Why do you think it's so evocative and why do you think it's used in this way?
sentences.zh: 为什么你觉得它这么有感染力，为什么你觉得它会被这样使用？

sentences.en: Are you troubled by it in any way or are you, you know, kind of pleased when you see it depicted?
sentences.zh: 你对它有什么困扰吗，还是说，你知道的，当你看到它被描绘时你有点高兴？

sentences.en: You know, I think the way it's come to be is a combination of two things.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为它变成今天是两种因素结合的结果。

sentences.en: And the one is that Ponti has become this sort of metaphor for Johannesburg and for South Africa
sentences.zh: 其中之一是庞蒂已经成为约翰内斯堡和南非的一种隐喻，

sentences.en: and this kind of outsized thing on the skyline onto which people can project their fears about the city
sentences.zh: 它就像天际线上一个夸张的存在，人们可以将他们对这座城市的恐惧投射在上面，

sentences.en: and what it's becoming.
sentences.zh: 投射到它正在变成的模样上。

sentences.en: And I think filmmakers have just picked up on that.
sentences.zh: 我想电影制作者们只是注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: And then the other thing is the aesthetic of the building is just pretty wild.
sentences.zh: 另一个因素是这座建筑的美学实在是非常狂野。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just the sort of 50 stories of raw, brutal concrete.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这可是整整50层裸露的粗野主义混凝土。

sentences.en: It's got these kind of exposed concrete ribs on the inside.
sentences.zh: 它的内部有那种暴露的混凝土肋条。

sentences.en: The core is just this crazy, rocky space.
sentences.zh: 核心区就像是一个疯狂的、岩石密布的空间。

sentences.en: You stare up and there's like 50 stories of windows staring back down at you
sentences.zh: 你抬头向上看，有大约50层楼的窗户在那种光井中，

sentences.en: in this sort of shaft of light.
sentences.zh: 反过来盯着你看。

sentences.en: It's almost otherworldly.
sentences.zh: 它几乎超乎想象。

sentences.en: So it has this very cinematic quality to it.
sentences.zh: 所以它具有非常强烈的电影质感。

sentences.en: But I do find the, you know, the way it appears in popular culture troubling
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得，你知道的，它在流行文化中出现的方式令人困扰，

sentences.en: because I think it sort of freezes in time, this very negative vision of Johannesburg
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这把约翰内斯堡非常负面的愿景，

sentences.en: and this vision of Ponti.
sentences.zh: 以及庞蒂的这种形象给永久定格在了某个时间点上。

sentences.en: And Ponti and Johannesburg both have changed and are changing, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且庞蒂和约翰内斯堡其实都变了，并且正在改变，你知道的，

sentences.en: sort of extraordinarily quickly, I think.
sentences.zh: 以一种我看来非常惊人的速度。

sentences.en: And maybe you could say that about any city,
sentences.zh: 也许你对任何城市都可以这么说，

sentences.en: but I think Johannesburg is a particularly unsentimental kind of city.
sentences.zh: 但我认为约翰内斯堡是一种极其不念旧情的城市。

sentences.en: And it's because it was started as this sort of mining town.
sentences.zh: 这是因为它最初是作为一个采矿城镇起家的。

sentences.en: It's always been a place where people just came to make money, to get rich, to get ahead.
sentences.zh: 这里一直是个让人来赚钱、发财、出人头地的地方。

sentences.en: People don't have this kind of sentimental attachment to home in Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 在约翰内斯堡，人们对家乡没有这种温情脉脉的依恋。

sentences.en: And so the city sort of moves on and forgets very quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以这座城市会不断向前发展，并且遗忘得非常快。

sentences.en: But then when you have the arbiters of popular culture,
sentences.zh: 但随后，当流行文化的仲裁者们，

sentences.en: when you have filmmakers come in and create this or, you know,
sentences.zh: 当电影制作者们进来创造或，你知道的，

sentences.en: sort of reinforce this vision of Joburg or of Ponti
sentences.zh: 某种程度上巩固了这种对约堡或庞蒂的愿景——

sentences.en: as these really dangerous, gritty, crime-ridded spaces,
sentences.zh: 将其视为真正危险、粗粝、充斥着犯罪的空间时，

sentences.en: it kind of freezes that image in people's minds.
sentences.zh: 它就在人们脑海中把这种形象给固定了下来。

sentences.en: And that's sort of what they think the city is like, whether or not it still is.
sentences.zh: 无论它现在是否还是那样，这正是他们认为这座城市该有的样子。

sentences.en: And you lived there for a time, right?
sentences.zh: 而你曾在那儿住过一段时间，对吧？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I lived there for about a year, coinciding with the filming of the Resident Evil movie.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿住了大约一年，正好赶上《生化危机》电影的拍摄。

sentences.en: So I was treated to a number of days of the zombie apocalypse
sentences.zh: 所以我体验了好几天的僵尸末日，

sentences.en: and literally zombies wandering through my building screaming,
sentences.zh: 真的有僵尸在我楼里游荡并尖叫，

sentences.en: which seemed a sort of logical endpoint to this Ponti metaphor.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是对这个庞蒂隐喻的一种符合逻辑的终点。

sentences.en: In what way?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, if Ponti sort of represents the sort of chaotic way
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果庞蒂某种程度上代表了那种混乱的方式，

sentences.en: that Johannesburg has evolved since the end of apartheid
sentences.zh: 即约翰内斯堡自种族隔离结束以来演变的方式，

sentences.en: and the disarray of the city in that period,
sentences.zh: 以及这座城市在那段时期的混乱状态，

sentences.en: I mean, what represents disarray more than a zombie apocalypse?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还有什么比僵尸末日更能代表混乱呢？

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Ryan Brown and Dasha Moodley with Delaney Hall.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由瑞安·布朗（Ryan Brown）和达沙·穆德利（Dasha Moodley）与德兰尼·霍尔（Delaney Hall）共同制作。

sentences.en: Mix and tech production by Sharif Yusuf.
sentences.zh: 混音和技术制作由谢里夫·优素福（Sharif Yusuf）负责。

sentences.en: Music by Sean Rial with an additional song by Jenny Conley-Drizos,
sentences.zh: 音乐由肖恩·里亚尔（Sean Rial）创作，并包含珍妮·康利-德里佐斯（Jenny Conley-Drizos）、

sentences.en: John Neufeld, and Nate Query.
sentences.zh: 约翰·诺伊费尔德（John Neufeld）和内特·奎里（Nate Query）的额外曲目。

sentences.en: Our senior producer is Katie Mingle.
sentences.zh: 我们的资深制作人是凯蒂·明格尔（Katie Mingle）。

sentences.en: Kurt Kolstad is the digital director.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔stad（Kurt Kolstad）是数字总监。

sentences.en: But we all add in our two cents, including Emmett Fitzgerald,
sentences.zh: 但我们所有人都贡献了自己的微薄之力，包括埃mett菲茨杰拉德（Emmett Fitzgerald）、

sentences.en: Avery Truffelman, Taryn Mazza, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 艾弗瑞·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffelman）、塔林·马扎（Taryn Mazza），以及我，罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Ingrid Martins, who allowed us to use audio from her film,
sentences.zh: 特别感谢英格丽德·马丁斯（Ingrid Martins），她允许我们使用其电影中的音频，

sentences.en: Africa Shafted.
sentences.zh: 片名为《非洲轴心》（Africa Shafted）。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 在美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心电台路（Radio Row）制作。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is part of Radiotopia from PRX,
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》是PRX旗下Radiotopia的一部分，

sentences.en: a collective of the best, most innovative shows in all of podcasting.
sentences.zh: 这是一个汇集了整个播客界最优秀、最具创新性节目的联盟。

sentences.en: We are supported by the Knight Foundation and coin-carrying listeners just like you.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了奈特基金会（Knight Foundation）以及像你这样兜里揣着硬币的听众的支持。

sentences.en: You can find 99% Invisible and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到《99% Invisible》并参与关于节目的讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me, at Roman Mars, and the show at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上@我，@Roman Mars，也可以@节目官方账号 99pi.org。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and Reddit, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在Instagram、Tumblr和Reddit上。

sentences.en: But if you want to read a cool article by Kurt about fictional megacities in science fiction,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想阅读库尔特写的一篇关于科幻小说中虚构特大城市的酷炫文章，

sentences.en: you have to go to our website.
sentences.zh: 你必须访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: It's 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是 99pi.org。

sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
